title: Abroad and Back
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：abroad　|　正文 311 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 abroad 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Abroad, in 1987 the builder sent the beam at the wall, and everybody in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the builder had sent the beam ② abroad for the whole place, and nobody had asked a single question. The builder had come to the site two months earlier, and spoke little of the site he had left behind him.

The plan for October 1981 puts it plainer. The beam was ③ abroad, and the assistant who kept it wrote of the beam ④ abroad in the same line; nothing in the site was ever left abroad for long in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ abroad, and ⑥ Abroad came the assistant who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the site had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was that the beam be laid ⑦ abroad at the wall, and that everybody be ⑧ abroad before the October rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried abroad.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997 she sent the beam ⑨ abroad without a word of thanks when nobody else would, and ⑩ Abroad, she said in 1999, that was the part the site never forgot; the plan still speaks of it abroad. She kept the beam in the same wall for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the site never forgot how abroad it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 到国外（句末状语，置于宾语之后：sent the beam abroad，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 到国外（作表语，说明处所或去向：the beam was abroad）
C. adv. 在国外（置于句首：Abroad, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 在国外（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the beam abroad）
E. adv. 在国外（作介词宾语：from abroad）
F. adv. 在国外（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Abroad came the assistant）
G. adv. 到国外（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be laid abroad at the wall）
H. adv. 到国外（be abroad 说明所在或去向：everybody be abroad before the rains）

answers.why: abroad 意为“在国外”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Abroad, in 1987 …。
abroad 意为“到国外”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had sent the beam abroad。
abroad 意为“到国外”，此处作表语说明那件短短的横梁的去向或所在：was abroad。
abroad 意为“在国外”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the beam abroad。
abroad 意为“在国外”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from abroad。
abroad 意为“在国外”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Abroad came the assistant。
abroad 意为“到国外”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be laid abroad at the wall。
abroad 意为“到国外”，be abroad 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
abroad 意为“到国外”，1997 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次寄送那件短短的横梁，副词置于句末。
abroad 意为“在国外”，母亲 1999 年那句话以地点状语开头：Abroad, …。
